name: Separate stated facts from implications
short_description: Separate stated facts from implications once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can separate stated facts from implications in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Separate stated facts from implications means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Separate stated facts from implications in a fresh real-life scenario.
